name: Infantry_Chat
author: Infantry AI
description: COMMS mail tools: inbox, read, message, announce and the project directory. Daemon half only: mail tools and the image upload frames.

tools.name: infantry_announce
tools.description: Announce one message to every live agent of your project (one COMMS mail each). Only the roles in setting announce.allowedRoles (default owner, pm) may announce.

tools.name: infantry_inbox
tools.description: Your COMMS inbox: counts and one line per item, newest unread first. Params: limit, offset, unreadOnly, previews.

limit.description: At most this many items (default: setting limits.tools.inboxLimit, 20).

offset.description: Skip this many items (paging; 0 = the newest).

unreadOnly.description: Only the messages not read yet.

previews.description: Add a one-line preview of each body (default false).

tools.name: infantry_read
tools.description: Read one message of your inbox in full and mark it read.

messageId.description: Message id from infantry_inbox, or a unique prefix of one.

bodyChars.description: Cut the body to this many characters (default: the whole body).

tools.name: infantry_message
tools.description: Send COMMS mail to an agent id, a role, a session id, or role@project (needs allowCrossProject).

to.description: Recipient: agent id, role, session id, or role@<project id or name> (cross-project, with allowCrossProject).

allowCrossProject.description: Send even though the recipient is in another project (refused by default).

tools.name: infantry_projects
tools.description: Look up projects: id, name, description and the roles with a live session.
